scientific_integrity: The analytical proof supports all stated claims; numerical sphere-grid computations provide supplementary checks only. The regular-cube probability and the mean section-vertex count were previously known.
scientific_limitations: Strict majorization only for positive rectangular boxes under translation-invariant affine-plane measure; local Hessian at the cube for fixed-sum perturbations; no general-shape or alternative-sampling assertion; potential historical-priority uncertainty.
title: Sharp triangular-section probability and local stability for random affine cuts of rectangular boxes
